versions.changelog:
Initial release of the "find-skills" skill.

- Helps users discover and install agent skills based on their needs or queries.
- Guides users in searching, verifying, and selecting skills from the open agent skills ecosystem.
- Explains how to use the Skills CLI and browse the skills leaderboard.
- Emphasizes verifying skill quality before recommending.
- Includes tips for effective searches and advice when no relevant skills are found.
